alternatives.argument: The complete local proof computes the covariance of D/2+Z and D/2-Z, factors their joint Gaussian characteristic function using the declared multivariate-normal supplier, and inducts over each finite tree depth; parent-sum consistency is algebraic at every split.

The complete local proof establishes the stopped-step integral identity by deterministic dyadic ceiling approximation, proves an L2 path-supremum moment bound by localization, Doob and Gronwall, bounds integrated within-step increments using the stopping-interval Itô isometry, then applies the coefficient time modulus and Gronwall. It explicitly restricts the theorem to predictable grids.

The complete local proof derives the endpoint joint density from the published reflection identity, identifies its regular conditional bridge law from the explicit Gaussian bridge disintegration, proves continuity in the terminal endpoint using absolute continuity before the terminal time, and evaluates the Gaussian density ratio.
